summary.text: Jim O'Day is a Democratic state representative from the 14th Worcester District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since 2007 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A licensed social worker by profession, he sits on the House Committees on Operations, Facilities and Security and on Post Audit and Oversight.

paragraphs.text: Jim O'Day holds a bachelor's degree in urban studies and management from Worcester State University.
His professional experience includes working as a licensed social worker with the Department of Social Services.

He has been a member of the West Boylston Democratic Town Committee, and his legislative biography also lists service on the West Boylston Town Parks and Facilities Committee and as co-chair of the Worcester Tree Initiative.
O'Day and his wife, Marybeth, have four children.
According to Ballotpedia, he has been an associate vice president of the Central Massachusetts Labor Council and a coach with Worcester Youth Flag Football and West Boylston Little League.
